# Soul Virtues Extractor
> The free 66-question Undertale soul trait assessment and multi-dimensional virtue calculator. Discover your percentage distribution across Determination, Bravery, Justice, Kindness, Patience, Integrity, and Perseverance.

Soul Virtues Extractor provides an interactive, client-side personality quiz based on the seven human soul traits from Undertale. It features 66 weighted statements, instant 7-trait breakdown, and shareable soul result cards.

## Core Features
- [Soul Virtues Test](https://soulvirtues.org/): Free 66-question online assessment and instant analysis
- [Seven Soul Virtues](https://soulvirtues.org/#virtues): In-depth guide to Determination, Bravery, Justice, Kindness, Patience, Integrity, and Perseverance
- [Scoring System](https://soulvirtues.org/#scoring): Multi-dimensional weighting and non-linear power curve algorithm

## Seven Undertale Soul Trait Guides
- [Determination Soul (Red)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/determination/): Willpower, resilience, lore, items, and battle mechanics
- [Bravery Soul (Orange)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/bravery/): Courage, initiative, lore, items, and combat mechanics
- [Justice Soul (Yellow)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/justice/): Fairness, accountability, lore, items, and shooter mechanics
- [Kindness Soul (Green)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/kindness/): Compassion, healing, lore, items, and shield mechanics
- [Patience Soul (Cyan)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/patience/): Calm timing, stillness, lore, items, and mechanics
- [Integrity Soul (Blue)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/integrity/): Moral honesty, authentic code, lore, items, and jump mechanics
- [Perseverance Soul (Purple)](https://soulvirtues.org/souls/perseverance/): Discipline, study, lore, items, and web movement mechanics

## Soul Comparison Matrix
- [Bravery vs Determination](https://soulvirtues.org/compare/bravery-vs-determination/): Action in fear versus refusal to accept defeat
- [Determination vs Perseverance](https://soulvirtues.org/compare/determination-vs-perseverance/): Rejecting endings versus disciplined routine
- [Integrity vs Justice](https://soulvirtues.org/compare/integrity-vs-justice/): Inner moral alignment versus outward fairness
- [Kindness vs Patience](https://soulvirtues.org/compare/kindness-vs-patience/): Active empathy versus calm waiting
- [Bravery vs Patience](https://soulvirtues.org/compare/bravery-vs-patience/): Immediate movement versus calculated pause
- [Justice vs Kindness](https://soulvirtues.org/compare/justice-vs-kindness/): Strict fairness versus gentle harm reduction
